groups.root_cause: A definitively rejected rerun request is never resolved, so the classification stays pending forever and never yields a fix result.
A CI inspection error on one PR stops the whole repository poll loop, so later PRs are never processed.
Persisted CI pauses skip the GraphQL-change guard, so every unchanged poll repeats REST inspection of each paused PR.
Repository URLs are compared case-sensitively, so valid jobs whose capitalization differs from the registered URL are rejected.
Failures classified as main-red are never written to the flake ledger.
Only the latest workflow attempt is examined, so a later sibling-job rerun hides the attempt the factory started.
Completed reruns with skipped or neutral conclusions are not treated as terminal, so they never resolve.
Main's legacy commit statuses are only checked when the PR also has legacy statuses, so a red main is missed.
Rerunning a job also reruns its downstream dependent security jobs, which ignores the security-test exclusion.
The decision to rerun a whole job doesn't check whether the job contains security-test steps, so those steps get rerun.
Timeout detection only recognizes Bun and Playwright diagnostics, so other test-runner timeouts are not treated as transient.
The feed excerpt takes the first 2000 characters of the raw log, which is runner-setup boilerplate rather than the failure context.
The failure signature uses the first line loosely matching error/fail, so distinct failures collide on the same signature.
The change is far larger than the requested source budget, including a redundant second migration for the same new table.
